An '''iron pickaxe''' is a [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]] of the [[Iron equipment|iron]] tier, crafted from three [[iron ingot]]s and two sticks. It is the first pickaxe that can harvest every ore in the pack, including diamond ore and [[native gold]], but not obsidian.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
The iron pickaxe breaks pickaxe blocks at speed {{Value|Iron Pickaxe|miningspeed}}, one faster than the [[copper pickaxe]] and the vanilla iron pickaxe, and has {{Value|Iron Pickaxe|durability}} durability, twice vanilla's 250.

Obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests break at speed 3 and drop nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/iron.json}}</ref> A [[steel pickaxe|steel]], [[diamond pickaxe|diamond]], [[electrum pickaxe|electrum]] or [[adamant pickaxe]], or any [[dolabra]], is needed to collect them; [[hepatizon pickaxe|hepatizon]] and [[shakudo pickaxe|shakudo]] pickaxes also collect crying obsidian and ender chests, but not obsidian.

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Iron Pickaxe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Iron Pickaxe|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into a single iron ingot, and at a [[smithing table]] it takes [[steel alloy]] to become its [[Steel equipment|steel]] counterpart.
